pages.text: The Auto Collector is the "harvester" of a crystal farm: it reaps mature clusters in range and tucks the drops (1-2 Akaishi Essence) into its own $(4)27-slot chest$(0).$(br2)$(bold)Four tiers$(0) (range side / time per cluster / energy per tick):$(li)$(4)Basic$(0): 3x3x3, 30 ticks, 2 E/t$(li)Medium: 5x5x5, 15 ticks, 4 E/t$(li)Advanced: 9x9x9, 7 ticks, 8 E/t$(li)Ultimate: 16x16x16, 2 ticks, 16 E/t$(br2)Idle with peace of mind: when its chest is full it stops working instead of breaking your clusters.

$(bold)Dream team: Catalyst + Collector = a fully automatic crystal farm.$(0)$(li)the Catalyst makes Geodes in range sprout clusters every tick$(li)the Collector then sweeps up the mature ones and stores the Essence$(br2)Place both with matching ranges and it runs on its own.$(br2)Hoppers and item pipes can pull the Essence out and feed it down the line — into a Compressor or whatever you need.
The "$(l:akaishi:catalyst)Catalyst$(/l)" supplies the clusters; follow "$(l:akaishi:pulverizer)Pulverizer$(/l)" to see where the Essence goes.
